Scrape single page with WARC output enabled writes to file

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'respect_robots_txt' => false, 'warc_output' => '/tmp/crawlberg_test.warc' }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages[0].status_code.inspect
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
